name: Difficult People
overview: Scripture calls believers to respond to difficult people with grace and love rather than anger or judgment. Proverbs teaches that gentle words can defuse wrath, while Jesus commands us to love our enemies, bless those who curse us, and pray for those who mistreat us, reflecting the kindness God shows to all. Forgiveness is essential in maintaining a right relationship with God and others, as we are reminded to forgive others so that we may also receive forgiveness. By embodying these attitudes, believers demonstrate their identity as children of God who mirror His mercy and patience.
